data.label: Customer Trust
data.title:
5 things customers check
*before calling you*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site passes →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Does it *look good* on phones?
data.body: Most local customers search on their phones. If your site is hard to read or zoom in on, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and click every button.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Are your *business hours* correct?
data.body: People need to know if you are open before they drive to your shop or call. Wrong info leads to lost trust.
data.fix: Fix: Update your hours in the website footer today.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Is your *service area* clear?
data.body: Customers won't call if they don't know if you work in their neighborhood. Don't make them guess where you operate.
data.fix: Fix: List your city or service area on the homepage.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Is your *phone number* clickable?
data.body: If a customer has to copy and paste your number, they will likely just call your competitor instead.
data.fix: Fix: Make your phone number a clickable link.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Are there *real photos*?
data.body: Stock photos look fake and generic. Real photos of your work prove you are a legitimate, local business.
data.fix: Fix: Upload three photos of your recent work.
